message.content: {"verdict":"FAIL","blockers":[{"field":"synthesis — What should be de-emphasized","problem":"This guidance sidelines the compact-launch folding relationship, a central strand of the Selected Idea’s account of how launch constraints led into deployment.","outputQuote":"“De exacte afmetingen en het vouwontwerp voor de raket, afzonderlijke stappen van het zonneschild, grondbesturing en telemetrie zijn niet nodig om de centrale tegenstelling te begrijpen.”","evidenceLocation":"source","evidenceQuote":"“Webb's fully deployed operational configuration is far too large to fit into any available rocket so it was designed to fold into a compact launch configuration that fit inside the Ariane 5.”","correction":"Keep the compact-launch link in the guidance: note briefly that Webb had to fold to fit the Ariane 5, without requiring exact dimensions or detailed folding steps."}]}
